summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test for the iter-237 'account sync' feature (live role/status read in require_auth, role rename cascade, portal gate, and new /api/admin/access-sync/* admin endpoints). Created /app/backend/tests/test_access_sync.py (18 parametrized tests). 16/18 PASS. 2 FAIL — both uncover the SAME real bug in backend/auth.py::_load_live_user (line 215): the 'blocked' predicate uses AND instead of OR, so only `is_active: False` deactivates — `status: 'inactive'` alone and `active: False` alone do NOT block the token. Spec explicitly says all three variants must 401 /api/auth/me. Everything else works: (1) live perm add (mod.hr_leave.view) takes effect on the same old token within ~1.5s, (2) PUT /users switching role to TEST_sync_b2 instantly flips /auth/me to new role + 'finance' portal + mod.fin_expenses.view usable, (3) PUT /roles rename TEST_sync_b2→TEST_sync_b3 cascades to the user doc and preserves permissions on the same token, (4) role_id is auto-synced on POST/PUT users (TestLiveRoleSwitch assertion), (5) portal/granular gate — DELETE /rahaza/employees/x returns 403 x-rbac-denied=1, POST /rahaza/expenses returns 403 cross-portal, GET reads remain allowed cross-portal as designed, (6) /api/admin/access-sync/{audit,fix,user/{uid}} all 403 for non-superadmin, /fix is idempotent (2nd call fixed=0), audit returns summary {total,ok,error,fixable} and per-user portals/perm_count/granular_portals, user/{uid} returns module_access + granular list. Frontend (static bundle) verified via Playwright on preview URL as superadmin: Portal Administrasi Sistem → Kontrol Akses → tab 'Cek Sinkron Akun' renders — all required data-testids present (access-sync-module, access-sync-summary, access-sync-ok, access-sync-error, access-sync-refresh, access-sync-fix), 38 rows (access-sync-row-<email>), 38 view buttons (access-sync-view-<email>), detail dialog (access-sync-detail) opens with Peran / Portal yang bisa dibuka / Izin per modul sections. Summary shows Total 38, Sinkron 38, Bermasalah 0 (production data healthy), Fix button disabled with '(0)'.

critical.issue: Deactivation only works via `is_active: False`. Setting `status: 'inactive'` alone or `active: False` alone does NOT block the old token — /auth/me keeps returning 200. Spec requires ANY of the three variants to 401. Root cause: backend/auth.py:215 uses AND instead of OR:  `blocked = u.get('is_active') is False or (u.get('status') not in (None, 'active') and not u.get('active', True))`. The parenthesised clause ties `status` and `active` together with AND, so each one alone is swallowed. Suggested fix: `blocked = (u.get('is_active') is False) or (u.get('active') is False) or (u.get('status') not in (None, 'active'))`. Verified reproducibly: parametrized test TestDeactivation ran all three variants — only `is_active=False` passed; the other two left the token working.

rca of the issue: Deactivation bug: backend/auth.py:_load_live_user computes `blocked = u.get('is_active') is False or (u.get('status') not in (None, 'active') and not u.get('active', True))`. When admin sets ONLY `status: 'inactive'`, mongo doc has status='inactive' and active defaults to True (via .get('active', True)) → `not True` = False → the AND clause evaluates False → blocked=False. Same analysis for `active: False` alone: status defaults to 'active' → `status not in (None,'active')` = False → AND clause False → blocked=False. Only `is_active: False` triggers the first disjunct. Fix: change AND to OR so each of the three signals independently blocks. Reproduction: TestDeactivation.test_deactivate_blocks_token[patch0] (status) and [patch1] (active) both fail with /auth/me 200; [patch2] (is_active) passes. Mitigation for user: admin UI should set all three fields to the same value on deactivation OR patch backend logic as above.
